unresolvedFindings: The guide says the ICC sample dashboard shows ratings such as “Low” and “Medium.” The supplied evidence does not support that claim or confirm which ratings the product offers.

The guide attributes “training campaigns, competency records and evidence capture” to the ICC setup description. The supplied evidence supports deployment with training and consultant review, but not those additional features.

The mapping chapter states that most plants collect incident and near-miss reports and that paper or email reports are not consistently logged, rated or linked to action. The supplied evidence does not establish those general claims about plants; the cited ICC page describes a problem pattern but provides no measured prevalence.
The claim that plants skipping reporter feedback tend to see reporting fall off is presented as a general tendency, but the supplied evidence does not support that causal claim.
